messages:
emma-sales: FYI we kicked off a POC with Meridian Bank. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC via groups, and domain ownership proof. Need a short runbook + pricing options for hosted vs dedicated.

raj-solutions: Can confirm SAML 2.0 supported (IdP/SP init). We require IdP metadata XML and public cert. We support persistent and transient NameID types. Do they have specific NameID format needs?

emma-sales: Buyer says persistent NameID (email-based). Also wants signed assertions and encrypted responses if possible.

maya-eng: Signed assertions SHA256 supported. Response encryption is optional on Hosted; available and simpler for Dedicated/Private since we can enforce mTLS. For SP-initiated flows provide our ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/<tenant>. Attribute mapping: email -> email, givenName, familyName. We can accept additional custom attributes under urn:custom:attrs.

ian-security: Security checklist items: cert thumbprint, expected assertion consumer URL, audience URI, NameID format, signing algorithm, whether they require assertion encryption, SCIM token rotation policy, IP allowlist. We should request their ATO/security questionnaire answers.

raj-solutions: SCIM details: we implement SCIM 2.0 endpoints: /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups. Bulk create up to 150 users/req. We support PATCH for groups and users. Group delta semantics are eventual; group member updates are applied in-order but may take a few seconds to reflect in our caches.

emma-sales: They asked about mapping groups to RBAC. What's the recommended flow?

maya-eng: Recommend provisioning SCIM groups that map to Redwood roles. We accept a group-level "redwood:role" extension claim, or we can map group.displayName -> role via a mapping table in Console. For POC provision starter roles: read-only, editor, owner. We can show a sample mapping in the runbook.

raj-solutions: Note on rate limits and pricing: Hosted SCIM and SAML auth checks are metered. Default SCIM rate limit = 10 req/s with burst up to 50. Hosted billing: per-provision API call + per-active-user monthly if they use our managed seats. Dedicated includes a provisioning allowance; extra calls billed. I'll draft two price bullets: (1) Hosted: $X/month + per-call; (2) Dedicated: flat reserved capacity + provisioning allowance.

ian-security: For domain verification we support DNS TXT verification and MX checks. For stricter setups we can require DNS TXT + email challenge. We also support enforcing an email domain allowlist and blocking external invites.

deploy-bot: [automated] Created ticket MER-POC-558 and attached SAML/SCIM checklist.

emma-sales: Action items: @maya-eng write 1-page SAML + SCIM runbook with sample SAML attribute mapping and SCIM JSON examples; @ian-security prepare answers to the security questionnaire and a short guidance doc on encryption/options; @raj-solutions produce pricing bullets (hosted vs dedicated) and rate-limit appendix. Target: EOD Thursday.

maya-eng: I'll add minimal SCIM examples here for the runbook:

```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "userName": "sarah@meridian.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Sarah","familyName":"Lee"},
  "emails": [{"value":"sarah@meridian.com","primary":true}],
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"]
}
```

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/abcd-1234
Authorization: Bearer <token>
[ {"op":"add","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-789"}]} ]
```

raj-solutions: And sample SAML attribute mapping snippet for metadata exchange:

```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3">
    <AttributeValue>user@example.com</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="redwood:role">
    <AttributeValue>editor</AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

ian-security: I'll attach the questionnaire template and point them to our security page: https://redwood.ai/security/sso-scim. Also note we can enable mTLS on Dedicated and Private.

emma-sales: Great. I'll send the runbook + questionnaire to the buyer after internal review. Thanks everyone.
